steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: How did we reach the bottom so quickly... I don't remember the water reaching here last time. Does this mean the other half of the monster has already...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hecate, stop! ${PlayerName} isn't here! There are only monsters and contamination here! If you keep fighting, you'll...

She rushes into the filth, which almost devours her. Suddenly, countless black shadows emerge from the ground. They shred the contaminants around Hecate, then firmly restrain the manic Nightmare and her master.
If you really want to find your Chief, you have to calm down first, you hear me?
A blue-haired girl emerges from the shadows.
Meanwhile, on the edge of a higher cliff, a few black ravens land quietly on a broken Nirvana mech to observe them.
